messages:
maya: FYI, after rolling r2.3 kernels yesterday we're seeing a ~35% token latency regression on long-seq traffic. CI perf suite flagged it during nightly run. @josh can you take a look? :grimacing:

josh: saw it. Perf CI shows kernel-selector changed score thresholds in commit 7b2f9d3. Bisect started locally.

ci-bot: Perf check failed on job perf/nightly/inference: latency_p50 increased from 42ms -> 57ms (34%). See: https://ci.redwood/example/perf/12345

josh: quick profiler dump — unusual KV cache miss pattern. For longer sequences KV cache lookups are ~30% slower. Dump: ```
KV hits: 68% -> 52%
avg_lookup_ms: 0.9 -> 1.4
```

anita: that matches a sim on my box when I forced batch_size variability. Batching heuristic picks larger micro-batches now which seems to interact poorly with the new kernel (gated on sequence_length>1024).

karim: hypothesis: kernel selector picks AVX-optimized kernel that has worse memory access pattern for KV-cache sharded layouts. We should bisect for the exact change.

josh: bisect instructions I used: ```git checkout release/2.3 && git bisect start HEAD v2.2.5 && git bisect run ./scripts/perf_smoke.sh``` found culprit 7b2f9d3 (kernel selector threshold tweak).

maya: ok. Patch options: revert that commit on release/2.3 or cherry-pick a targeted fix that restores old threshold only for kvcache-path. We need a hotfix cut today if customers are impacted.

josh: made a PR to backport minimal fix: https://git.redwood/pr/6789 - cherry-pick 7b2f9d3 with conditionals. CI unit + perf smoke added.

ci-bot: PR 6789 — perf smoke: now shows p50 44ms (near baseline). Full nightly still queued.

anita: can someone run a quick canary on staging with heavy long-seq load? I can run a 1h traffic replay.

karim: I'll deploy the backport build to canary pool and run replay. Deploying to canary/release-2.3 at sha a1c3b4f ...

release-bot: Deploy start: canary/release-2.3 @ a1c3b4f by karim. Notify: @oncall

maya: thanks. If canary looks good, we cut a hotfix branch release/2.3-hotfix-1 and cherry-pick PR 6789, tag, and trigger hotfix pipeline.

josh: one more note — tests found slight throughput dip for short sequences on the patched branch. It's within SLO but we should monitor after rollout.

karim: canary run: 30m done, replay shows kv hit-rate = 66% and p50 45ms. No errors. I'm rolling to 10% prod shard.

maya: rolling to 10% — good. After 1h, if no regressions, we'll merge to release and cut hotfix.

josh: added post-rollout checklist in PR: smoke, perf, trace sampling, alert thresholds. /assign @anita @karim

anita: ack. I'll watch alerts and run additional variance tests.

maya: update: 1h after 10% roll, metrics stable. Proceed to 100% roll and tag hotfix. :tada:

release-bot: Hotfix release created: release/2.3-hotfix-1 tag v2.3.1 deployed. Changelog: backport kernel-selector conditional to avoid kv-cache regression.

ci-bot: Nightly perf: p50 restored to 43ms. Closed perf alert.

maya: postmortem todo: short blameless note, add regression test for kv-cache+long-seq profile, and add guard in kernel selector CI. I'll draft.
